items.title: Compare proofbound and Orchestrate tracked baseline
items.context: Establish the exact tracked diff from Orchestrate main to proofbound main and separate code/config/docs from retired-root local warnings and legacy evidence.
items.userSees: The terminal prints `39 files changed, 4606 insertions(+), 139 deletions(-)` for the tracked Orchestrate-vs-proofbound baseline diff, with AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md listed only as excluded root-doc drift.

happy.desc: git diff --stat against the legacy ref lists the expected tracked code/config/docs differences.

edge.desc: AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md retired-root warning differences are identified as proofbound exclusions, not imported baseline content.

adversarial.desc: Untracked Orchestrate experiments and local evidence do not appear in the import candidate set.

verificationEvidence.command: git diff --stat HEAD..refs/remotes/orchestrate/main -- package.json package-lock.json packages/main/package.json lattice.config.json packages/main/src scripts docs/requirements AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md
verificationEvidence.note: Baseline stat including root-doc exclusions printed 39 files changed, 4606 insertions(+), 139 deletions(-); allowed import surface alone is 37 files changed, 4592 insertions(+), 139 deletions(-).
AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md account for 2 excluded files / 14 insertions of retired-root warning drift and will not be imported.

verificationEvidence.command: git diff --stat HEAD..refs/remotes/orchestrate/main -- .lattice/local-evidence experiments docs/story tests/fixtures && git diff --name-only HEAD..refs/remotes/orchestrate/main -- .lattice/local-evidence docs/story tests/fixtures
verificationEvidence.note: Excluded audit showed experiments-only tracked drift under experiments plus no output for .lattice/local-evidence, docs/story, or tests/fixtures; none are import candidates.

items.title: Import canonical tracked code and config changes without legacy evidence
items.context: Apply the Orchestrate 0.3.63 tracked source/config/docs baseline into proofbound while excluding old local evidence, dirty untracked experiments, and Orchestrate-specific retired-root warning text.
items.userSees: The terminal path audit prints `excludedRootDocs: clean` and `excludedLegacyEvidence: clean` while imported tracked paths show source/config/docs changes only.

happy.desc: Tracked code/config/docs selected for import match Orchestrate main after exclusions.

edge.desc: AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md are not overwritten by Orchestrate retired-root warning text.

adversarial.desc: No files under .lattice/local-evidence, experiments, docs/story, or tests/fixtures are staged for import.

verificationEvidence.command: git diff --name-only refs/remotes/orchestrate/main -- package.json package-lock.json packages/main/package.json lattice.config.json packages/main/src scripts docs/requirements
verificationEvidence.note: After commit 15a3405d5, allowed tracked code/config/docs paths produced no diff against refs/remotes/orchestrate/main.
excludedRootDocs: clean; AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md were not overwritten by retired Orchestrate root warning text.

verificationEvidence.command: git diff --name-only HEAD -- .lattice/local-evidence experiments docs/story tests/fixtures && git status --short --branch
verificationEvidence.note: excludedLegacyEvidence: clean; no files under .lattice/local-evidence, experiments, docs/story, or tests/fixtures were staged/imported, and git status was clean on story/B-c76c.

items.title: Regenerate version artifacts consistently
items.context: After import, sync package-lock and build artifacts so proofbound package metadata reports the same CLI version as the canonical code baseline.
items.userSees: The version metadata check prints `package.json 0.3.63`, `packages/main/package.json 0.3.63`, and `package-lock root 0.3.63 / 0.3.63`.

edge.desc: package-lock root metadata is regenerated to 0.3.63 instead of copying the stale Orchestrate 0.3.49 lock metadata.

adversarial.desc: A version check fails if any package metadata surface remains at 0.3.60 or 0.3.49.

verificationEvidence.command: node - <<'NODE' ... version assertion for package.json and packages/main/package.json ... NODE
verificationEvidence.note: package.json 0.3.63 and packages/main/package.json 0.3.63 were printed and asserted after npm install.

verificationEvidence.command: npm install && node - <<'NODE' ... lock root assertion ... NODE
verificationEvidence.note: npm install succeeded; package-lock root printed 0.3.63 / 0.3.63, replacing stale copied 0.3.49 lock metadata.

verificationEvidence.command: node - <<'NODE' ... fail on 0.3.60 or 0.3.49 ... NODE && git status --short --branch
verificationEvidence.note: Assertion would exit nonzero if any checked metadata surface remained 0.3.60 or 0.3.49; it passed, and git status was clean on story/B-c76c after commit d64133fa5.

items.title: Verify proofbound reports the imported CLI baseline
items.context: Run focused build/version checks to prove proofbound no longer lags behind Orchestrate before continuing retired-root guard work.
items.userSees: The terminal prints `Lattice CLI 0.3.63` from `node bin/lattice.js --version`, after `npm --prefix packages/main run build` and `npm --prefix packages/utils run build` both pass.

happy.desc: npm --prefix packages/main run build and npm --prefix packages/utils run build both succeed after baseline import.

edge.desc: node bin/lattice.js --version reports Lattice CLI 0.3.63 from proofbound, independent of the global fallback.

adversarial.desc: git status review shows no legacy evidence or Orchestrate-only retired-root warning files were imported.
